author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Integalactic: The Heretic Prophet is in the 'last stages of production,' according to developer Naughty Dog. Studio head Neil Druckmann also said the game is a mash-up of The Last of Us, Uncharted, and Jak and Daxter, if that gives you an idea of the style of gameplay the devs are going for. In other news, Marvel 1943: The Rise of Hydra is also nearing completion, but its long and troubled development caused the developers to cut content and the overall length of the game. And finally, Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting a Firefight mode, but not the multiplayer arena mode fans were hoping for.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Naughty Dog's Intergalactic Is in the 'Last Stages of Production' - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Long before intricately staged planning boards and deft teamwork became the norm for heist missions, one chaotic morning in Liberty City delivered gaming’s ultimate homage to pure cinematic grit. "Three Leaf Clover" strips away the safety nets, needle drops, and hand-holding mechanics to throw Niko Bellic straight into unforgiving, deafening crossfire through the canyons of Chinatown and the narrow warrens of the city's subway. It is a masterclass in escalating panic, where bickering mobsters, volatile physics, and an understated sound mix ape the stripped-back, diegetic intensity of Michael Mann’s Heat to brilliant effect. It's not just about the duffel bags and balaclavas: GTA 4's intimate understanding of cinema is key.
In this edition of Art of the Level we examine the audio architecture and cinematic minimalism behind Grand Theft Auto IV’s most iconic mission, and discover how Rockstar Games leveraged the Euphoria physics engine and Michael Mann’s signature filmography — from the
title: How GTA 4's Botched Bank Job Changed Level Design Forever – Art of the Level

author: IGN
description:
In Sankan, you work the night shift at a gas station on an old mountain road in Yamanashi. Make coffee, stock shelves, mop floors, smoke under the canopy. Serve customers, talk to them, check their cars and their stories. Every shift the voice names one of them. Kill him, and you and your friends have to mop the blood before the next car and bury the body before dawn. The people you met come back in later shifts. So does what you did. Refuse the voice, and the night turns on you: the lights go out and you have to survive until morning. Stay together and pick up the fallen.

No voice acting, everyone talks in subtitles. Several endings. Wishlist Sankan on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2131760/SANKAN/
title: Sankan - Official Reveal Trailer
